title: Folio 2: Two Brothers, One Throne | The Honest Historian – Stories from Beyhaqi
description:
In the spring of 1030, the great Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni dies, and his empire is left to the wrong son. His elder son Masud is far away in Isfahan, and his younger son Muhammad is already on the throne. Over six tense months, letters fly, armies change sides, and a kingmaker learns the price of making kings. Beyhaqi, who knew these men, tells us how it really went.

Source: Tarikh-e Beyhaqi, the surviving part of volume five: the letter from Tiginabad, the arrest of Hajib Ali in Herat, and Masud's arrival in Balkh (421 AH / 1030 CE).
Retold in English from the Persian original by Mehdi Rahmani and narrated with an AI rendering of his own voice.
